acceptance_predicates.description: The role-store doctor rejects an assignment whose role is not authorized by the durable role store, with no fail-open fallback.
Lifecycle admission rejects an owner absent from the durable role store, with no implicit owner creation or fallback.
Valid durable role assignments continue to pass doctor and lifecycle admission checks.
Focused positive and negative contract tests cover accepted, missing, stale, unauthorized-role, and unknown-owner cases.
The repair changes only the coordinator role-store runtime/test seam and does not alter downstream ASB vendor files or AR-1849-owned behavior.

definition_of_done: The smallest upstream role-store authorization repair is implemented on an exact reviewed product head.
Native, role/lifecycle, schema, privacy, and required hosted checks pass.
Independent exact-head review confirms fail-closed doctor and lifecycle admission semantics.
The exact reviewed result is handed to downstream ASB for requalification.

inputs.description: The immutable Coordinator v0.7.4 source and its role-store behavior.
ASB AR-1852 role-store compatibility failure evidence, used only as downstream contract context.

outputs.description: A signed, independently reviewed upstream role-store authorization repair.
Concise positive and negative test evidence for doctor and lifecycle admission.

gates.description: Independent review covers the exact product commit and confirms the scoped role-store repair.
Required native and hosted quality checks pass on the exact reviewed head.
ASB can consume the exact reviewed result and rerun AR-1852 without vendor mutation in this task.
